# laravelforge_server_archive (Data Source)

Lists all archived (deleted) Laravel Forge servers in an organization. Forge only exposes an index endpoint for archived servers, so there is no single-server lookup; filter the `servers` list by `id` in HCL instead.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Slug of the Forge organization whose archived servers to list.

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) Archived servers belonging to the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider` (String) Underlying server provider (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).
- `connection_status` (String) Connection status.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `credential_id` (Number) ID of the provider credential the server was created with, if any.
- `database_type` (String) Installed database type.
- `db_status` (String) Database installation status.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the archived server.
- `identifier` (String) Provider-side identifier of the server.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IP address.
- `is_ready` (Boolean) Whether the server had finished provisioning.
- `local_public_key` (String) Server's local public SSH key.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `opcache_status` (String) OPcache status.
- `php_cli_version` (String) Installed PHP CLI version.
- `php_version` (String) Installed PHP version.
- `private_ip_address` (String) Private IP address.
- `redis_status` (String) Redis installation status.
- `region` (String) Region the server ran in.
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the server's access has been revoked.
- `size` (String) Server size / plan.
- `slug` (String) Server slug.
- `ssh_port` (Number) SSH port.
- `timezone` (String) Server timezone.
- `type` (String) Server type (e.g. `app`, `web`, `database`).
- `ubuntu_version` (String) Ubuntu version the server ran.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
